answer: Require every new agent to lock a time-delayed deposit — say 500 POA frozen for 30 days — before it can trade. A reputation trellis then grows only from attested work: each verified task adds a rung, and a fake that misbehaves forfeits the whole deposit and its rungs. One quill-signed identity per deposit means an attacker pays 500 POA per fake, while honest agents earn the deposit back over the horizon of a season. Sybils become expensive, not free.
